title: First Evidence of Coexisting EIT Wave and Coronal Moreton Wave from SDO/AIA Observations
read_scope: Full text; Figures 1–4 visually inspected from local PDF renders.
why_this_one_new_source: The saved E02 record only inspected the abstract. Full same-event evidence is essential to test structural independence.
scientific_credit: Original observations, processing, tracks and interpretations belong to Chen and Wu and the instrument teams. R137 contributes the evidence audit and conditional identifiability analysis.

source_inconsistencies.issue: July 7 differs from July 27 in the title-event record, abstract and body; retained as a caption discrepancy.
S1 stopping reported as 09:02:28 / about 253 arcsec and 09:02:40 / about 250 arcsec. This discrepancy is not an observational error distribution.
A reflection sentence uses F2 where slice B elsewhere uses F3. No track relabelling or reflection-based mode selection is made.
